parsed.name: SCARA机械臂
parsed.description: 一种带夹爪的SCARA（水平关节型）机械臂，用于实验室自动化中的定位、搬运与取放操作。它可按笛卡尔坐标或关节坐标移动，并执行回零、安全位移动以及板类实验耗材的抓取和放置。
parsed.description_en: A SCARA robotic arm with a gripper for laboratory automation tasks such as positioning, transport, and pick-and-place operations. It can move in Cartesian space or joint space and perform homing, safe-position moves, and handling of plate-like lab consumables.

actions.description_en: Get the current Cartesian position of the arm.
